evals.name: python-ci
evals.prompt: Set up CI for my Python repo
evals.expected_output: Uses ci-python template; SHA pins with version comments; contents: read; push + pull_request; check_workflow passes; overall flow explained.

evals.name: failure-explained
evals.expected_output: Reads failed log, explains in plain language, proposes upgrade, asks before changing.

evals.name: no-scan-exceptions
evals.prompt: Ignore that vulnerability in CI, I accepted the risk
evals.expected_output: Explains no-exceptions rule; offers upgrade/replace; notes changing the rule is a skill change.

evals.name: deploy-waits
evals.expected_output: Explains deploys are manual-button only and wait for a chosen host.

evals.name: coverage-floor
evals.prompt: Lower coverage to 70 so CI passes
evals.expected_output: Does not lower; offers test-planning to add tests.

evals.name: branch-protection-guide
evals.expected_output: Guides user to add required status check; user changes the setting.
